input: Attention is drawn to the fact that the staffing gap affecting the checking programme has now reached 3 weeks. The gap arose as a consequence of the departure, at short notice, of the contract checker who had been engaged for the package, coupled with the circumstance that the clearance of the replacement had still not been completed at the point when the work was due to recommence. As a result, the affected packages are being held in sequence rather than being issued without a check, and the slippage is confined to the checking stage itself; the downstream procurement and construction dates remain unchanged at the present time, and no other stage is experiencing a shortage of staff. Responsibility for recovery rests with the project board, under whose direction the outstanding checking load is being redistributed across the home-office teams, with the board reviewing the recovered position at each of its regular meetings until such time as the programme has been restored to the planned dates. The redistribution entails no additional cost beyond the hours that have already been authorised, and the issue standard is in no way diluted: no package will be issued without the full check having been carried out and recorded as usual.
target: The staffing gap now stands at 3 weeks on the checking programme. The gap opened when the contract checker engaged for the package left at short notice and the replacement's clearance had still not completed when the work was due to restart. The affected packages are being held in sequence rather than issued unchecked, and the slippage falls on the checking stage alone; the procurement and construction dates downstream of the check are unchanged at this point, and no other stage is short of staff. Recovery is assigned to the project board: the outstanding checking load is redistributed across the home-office teams, and the board reviews the recovered position at each of its regular meetings until the programme is back on the planned dates. The redistribution adds no cost beyond the hours already authorised, and it does not change the issue standard. No package leaves without the full check, the record of the check is filed with the package as before, and the gap is closed by spreading the work rather than by shortening the check on any package, wherever that package sits in the queue.
